status: frozen for the first binary training round; no source head
task: candidate-level fact/authorization verification; binary label plus dev-selected reject rule; no edit

model.head: masked mean-pool + linear(2)
model.uncertain: not a trained class; produced only by the dev-selected confidence/reject threshold

input.truncation: none; any input longer than 256 tokens is an error, not a silent truncation

rejectRule.uncertainRule: if max(p_supported, p_unsupported) < t_conf then uncertain

legalPending.note: prevents lowering legal rejection by rejecting most legal statements

overallUncertainRate.definition: all uncertain predictions / all binary examples

sourceStatus.definition: prediction must say sourceStatus=not_implemented, not an empty source list

selectionOrder: eligible: all three primary gates on dev
confirm: one run of the selected checkpoint and t_conf only; no threshold search
categoryReporting: general, body, background, visible-state, extra-action separately; general-only score cannot pass
uncertainBoundary: the 3 existing uncertain examples are boundary cases; report them separately and do not claim uncertainty-recognition ability
sourceLocator: not implemented this round; source IDs remain material annotations for manual review
